verdict.rationale: YYLO's integrations doc says it can bring Slack messages or GitHub issues into its kanban and return completed responses to their source thread. Its site also claims it can delegate bounded work across agents. Together these approximate thread-based delegation through a CLI orchestrator, not an in-chat agent you converse with. Missing for 10: explicit @-mention/tagging of an agent in a chat thread, interactive back-and-forth discussion in the thread, setup/trigger details for the Slack/GitHub integration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
